create_DiffusersQuantizer: create a DiffusersQuantizer instance with a QuantizationConfigMixin to quantize a diffusers model
build_quantize_model: build a quantized diffusers model by calling preprocess_model before weight loading
test_quantizer_environment: test the quantizer environment by calling validate_environment before loading weights
review_dequantize_model: review the dequantize method to restore a quantized model to its original unquantized state
summarize_postprocess_model: summarize the postprocess_model method that runs after weight loading to finalize quantization
